title: Norway's biggest bank DNB to lay off around 400 staff amid AI-driven changes
key_facts: DNB will lay off around 400 employees in its Technology & Services unit, Norway's largest bank said on Tuesday.
CEO Kjerstin Braathen: 'AI is changing the way we work and how we deliver services to our customers'; she called it 'a new reality'.
DNB has adopted AI agents to replace tasks previously handled manually in some operations.
Cuts expected to complete in Q4 2026, with costs booked in Q2 2027.
DNB shares rose 1% after the announcement.
quote_evidence: DNB will lay off around 400 employees in its Technology & Services unit, Norway's largest bank said on Tuesday, citing increased investments in AI agents and digital solutions that had led to changes in the organization.
DNB shares rose 1% following the announcement
